dish.title: Thai Khao Man Gai: Poached Chicken and Garlic-Ginger Rice with Soybean Sauce
dish.description: Bangkok's hawker classic: chicken thighs gently poached with ginger and cilantro stems, jasmine rice cooked in the poaching broth with garlic and ginger, and a punchy sauce of fermented soybean paste, ginger, garlic, chile, and vinegar. Served with cucumber and a cup of the broth.

recipe_version.title: Thai Khao Man Gai: Poached Chicken and Garlic-Ginger Rice with Soybean Sauce
recipe_version.description: Bangkok's hawker classic: chicken thighs gently poached with ginger and cilantro stems, jasmine rice cooked in the poaching broth with garlic and ginger, and a punchy sauce of fermented soybean paste, ginger, garlic, chile, and vinegar. Served with cucumber and a cup of the broth.

ingredients.name: fresh ginger
ingredients.note: 2 inches sliced for the poach, 1 inch minced for the rice, 1 inch minced for the sauce

ingredients.name: cilantro
ingredients.note: stems for the poach, leaves to garnish

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.note: 5 for the rice, 3 for the sauce

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Rinse the rice well and let it drain. Slice 2 inches of the ginger and mince the remaining 2 inches. Cut the cilantro stems from the leaves. Mince the garlic, slice the chiles, and slice the cucumber.

steps.title: Poach the chicken
steps.body: Put the chicken, 10 cups water, the sliced ginger, cilantro stems, and 2 tsp salt in a 6-quart stockpot. Bring to a bare simmer over medium-high, then lower the heat so only a few bubbles break the surface. Poach until the thickest thigh reads 175 F, about 30 minutes. Lift the chicken onto a plate and strain the broth.

steps.title: Toast the rice
steps.body: Heat the oil in a 3-quart saucepan over medium. Cook 5 cloves of garlic and 1 inch of minced ginger until fragrant and pale gold, about 1 minute. Add the drained rice and 1 tsp salt and stir 2 minutes to coat.

steps.title: Cook the rice in broth
steps.body: Add 2 1/2 cups of the strained broth, bring to a boil, cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes; then rest covered off the heat 10 minutes.

steps.title: Make the sauce and rest the chicken
steps.body: While the rice cooks, stir the soybean paste, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, the last 3 cloves of garlic, the last inch of ginger, and the chiles together. Keep the remaining broth hot over low. The chicken rests meanwhile (overlap stated).

steps.title: Slice and serve
steps.body: Slice the chicken off the bone into thick pieces, skin on. Pack rice onto each plate, fan the chicken beside it, and add cucumber and cilantro leaves. Serve with the sauce and a small cup of hot broth.

coverage_contribution: Thai poultry main beyond larb (thai-turkey-larb-lettuce-wraps). Poached chicken is a new technique for the catalog. Light, non-fried, non-coconut chicken and rice.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with vietnamese-chicken-pho: poached chicken over broth-cooked rice with a sauce, not a noodle soup. Compared with sheet-pan-lemon-herb-chicken: poached, not roasted. Compared with filipino-chicken-adobo: no vinegar-soy braise.
not_duplicate_of: Not Hainanese chicken rice under another name: this is the Thai version with tao jiao sauce. Not a rice bowl (bowls are closed): the plate is chicken, rice, sauce, and broth served separately.
